milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce stairs are at spawn-relative coordinates (~6, 0, ~4) and (~7, 0, ~4). Target is set to the midpoint of the two stairs blocks (6.5, 0, 4). The player must navigate near them and face them to demonstrate they found them. Max distance 16 allows detection from a reasonable range.

Uses inventory_has because when a spruce_pressure_plate is mined, it drops as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no spruce_pressure_plate, so having at least 1 confirms it was mined.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_pressure_plate (from 2 dark_oak_planks) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with no dark_oak_pressure_plate, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_sign (from 6 dark_oak_planks + 1 stick) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with no dark_oak_sign, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.
